note: Source catalog; source_index_only does not mean the platform has ingested, verified or licensed the source.

sources.name: UK Electoral Commission · political donations and loans
sources.caveat: Party/donor reporting; published quarterly or monthly

sources.name: Elections Canada · political finance open data
sources.kind: Official political entity submissions and reviewed returns
sources.caveat: Weekly CSV ZIP; campaign, party, third-party returns differ

sources.name: Australian Electoral Commission · disclosures
sources.caveat: Election-cycle and threshold effects; do not compare raw totals without normalization

sources.name: EU Transparency Register · interest representation
sources.caveat: Registration is not proof of lobbying success or hidden influence

sources.name: UK Companies House · corporate and PSC filings
sources.caveat: Free API key required; registered PSC ≠ necessarily actual ultimate owner

sources.name: European business registers (BRIS)
sources.caveat: Member-state access charges, update dates and reuse terms vary

sources.name: GLEIF · global legal entity IDs
sources.kind: Global LEI and legal relationship data
sources.caveat: No LEI is not evidence of concealment; reporting exceptions exist

sources.name: EITI · oil, gas and mining data
sources.kind: State resource payments, licences and reported entities
sources.caveat: Geographic coverage and transparency requirements vary

sources.name: UK CMA · competition enforcement cases
sources.caveat: Commitments and infringements have different legal posture

sources.name: Australia ACCC · competition and market inquiries
sources.caveat: Market analysis ≠ proof of specific illegal behaviour

sources.name: European Commission · Digital Markets Act enforcement
sources.caveat: Separate DMA from antitrust statutes and case status

sources.name: EU Digital Markets Act · consumer choice decisions
sources.kind: Regulatory consumer protection and platform rules
sources.caveat: Fines ≠ household compensation

sources.name: UK FCA · basic account access review
sources.caveat: Mystery-shop sample ≠ all customer experiences

sources.name: ACCC · grocery pricing and promotion research
sources.kind: Consumer surveys and retail pricing studies
sources.caveat: Historical research, not a live checkout audit

sources.name: UK FCA · financial-crime enforcement
sources.caveat: Keep fines, redress, monetary flows and allegations separate

sources.name: European Central Bank · supervisory banking statistics
sources.kind: Bank capital, asset quality and aggregated supervision
sources.caveat: Aggregated figures not individual bank misconduct or bailouts

sources.name: UK CMA · government bonds competition decisions
sources.caveat: Historical market conduct and individual penalties

sources.name: UK Find a Tender · OCDS awards
sources.caveat: Bounded first-page live feed already connected elsewhere in Eastern Axis

sources.name: EU Tenders Electronic Daily · TED
sources.kind: EU tender notices and contract awards
sources.caveat: Different member-state reporting thresholds; validate parties

sources.name: CanadaBuys · notices
sources.caveat: Contract outcome and supplier IDs require subsequent records

sources.name: World Bank · project procurement
sources.caveat: Coverage limited to financed projects, not all national contracts

sources.name: Eurostat · housing cost overburden
sources.caveat: >40% disposable income, net of housing allowances; not market rent

sources.name: World Bank · World Development Indicators
sources.kind: Three World Bank indicators summarized inside Eastern Axis with cited reporting years
sources.caveat: World Bank open-data snapshot captured 2026-11-16. Summary is displayed inside the dashboard; original publisher links are expandable within each indicator.

sources.name: International Labour Organization · ILOSTAT
sources.caveat: Different labor indicators and population denominators

sources.name: OECD · Public Integrity Indicators
sources.kind: Laws vs implementation across government systems
sources.caveat: De-jure scores and observed practice are different measures

sources.name: European Commission · EU Justice Scoreboard
sources.kind: Court performance and public oversight statistics
sources.caveat: National definitions vary; compare like measures

sources.name: UK National Audit Office · audits
sources.caveat: Critical audits are not necessarily criminal findings

sources.name: Competition Bureau Canada · enforcement outcomes
sources.kind: Official competition findings and consent agreements
sources.caveat: Bureau allegations, negotiated consent and Tribunal decisions have distinct legal status.

sources.name: Competition Bureau Canada · deceptive marketing decisions
sources.kind: Consumer advertising allegations, orders and settlements
sources.caveat: Check date, court status and stated penalty; no assumption of current violations.

sources.name: Brazil · CADE competition decisions
sources.kind: Official competition rulings, announcements and case references
sources.caveat: Distinguish staff recommendations from Tribunal decisions and subsequent litigation.

sources.name: Brazil · CADE public procurement cases
sources.caveat: Total procurement value is not proved taxpayer loss. Staff recommendations are not final findings.

sources.name: South Africa · Competition Commission
sources.kind: Competition Tribunal filings and settlement communications
sources.caveat: A negotiated settlement may explicitly disclaim admission of liability.

sources.name: India · Competition Commission of India
sources.caveat: Read primary orders and appeals; not yet ingested as a normalized case feed.

sources.name: Japan · Fair Trade Commission
sources.kind: Competition enforcement notices and policy decisions
sources.caveat: Official Japanese case records may need translation and careful appeal-status verification.
